g.text: (DNS → TLS → Weighted Backend Routing → A/B + Canary)
- Manages DNS records via Route53 API
- This demo focuses on traffic shaping
- Use case: Gradual rollout of new version
- Use case: Internal testers always get
• AWS Load Balancer: Outside OpenShift Cluster
